import pandas as pd

items = pd.read_csv("order_items.csv")
orders = pd.read_csv("orders.csv", parse_dates=["order_date"])
products = pd.read_csv("products.csv")
customers = pd.read_csv("customers.csv")
items["revenue"] = items["quantity"] * items["unit_price"] * (1 - items["discount"])

sales = (
    items.merge(orders, on="order_id", how="left", validate="many_to_one")
    .merge(products[["product_id", "name"]].rename(columns={"name": "product"}),
           on="product_id", how="left", validate="many_to_one")
    .merge(customers[["customer_id", "country"]], on="customer_id", how="left", validate="many_to_one")
)
print(len(sales))
sales = sales[sales["status"] != "cancelled"]

revenue_by_country = sales.groupby("country")["revenue"].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
print(revenue_by_country.round(2))
